# GEOAgent 接入

注册操作：

```python
from integration_adapter import plan_hierarchical_fiber_links

OPERATION_HANDLERS = {
    "plan_hierarchical_fiber_links": plan_hierarchical_fiber_links,
}
```

调用命令遵循 `task5.fiber-link.v1`：

```json
{
  "operation": "plan_hierarchical_fiber_links",
  "interface_version": "task5.fiber-link.v1",
  "base_dir": "D:/FTTH/任务5",
  "input": {"task6_plan": "../任务6/output/layered_plan.json"},
  "output": {"directory": "outputs/fiber_links"}
}
```

将返回结果中的 `output_paths.qgis_geojson` 加载为线图层。属性 `cable_cores`、`stage`、`physical_path_status` 和 `conduit_route_ids` 可用于渲染、审查和导出施工清单。
